name: cbt.worry-chain
title: CBT · Follow a worry chain
description: An optional scripted worry-chain example: your previous answer becomes the next hypothetical question. Stop the loop whenever you wish. Requires a local model for wording.

name: cbt.moment
title: CBT · Map one moment
description: Separate an event, its meaning, feelings and response, then choose what to explore next.

name: cbt.activation
title: CBT · One manageable action
description: Choose a small action connected to care or enjoyment, with a realistic fallback.

name: act.defusion
title: ACT · Notice a thought
description: Try noticing a thought as a mental event without arguing with it or forcing it away.

name: act.values
title: ACT · A values-led step
description: Name a freely chosen quality of action and one small way to live it.

name: dbt.pause
title: DBT · Pause and observe
description: Notice the situation and an urge, then decide whether to pause, seek support or take a safe next step.

name: dbt.interpersonal
title: DBT · Clarify a request or boundary
description: Balance your objective, the relationship and self-respect before drafting your own words.
